meta.scene_summary: We are building the future on top of a stack that currently considers MS Paint a security vulnerability.

cooking.headline: Perplexity is launching AI agents for work, effectively turning your inbox into a group project.
cooking.summary: Perplexity is rolling out AI agents that can handle complex work tasks, which is great until you realize you are now the manager of a digital team that never sleeps. It's essentially a way to assign tasks to software, hoping that the AI does more work than the guy who never shows up to the Zoom calls.
cooking.plain_english: Perplexity has introduced a new feature that allows AI-powered agents to perform complex, multi-step work tasks for users.

cooking.headline: Nvidia Kubernetes Engine is here because we clearly didn't have enough layers
cooking.summary: Just when you thought your cluster couldn't get any more complex, someone decided to wrap the entire Nvidia ecosystem in Kubernetes. It's the infrastructure equivalent of deciding your house needs a second roof just to make sure the first one stays dry.
cooking.plain_english: A new tool has been released to manage Nvidia computing resources within the Kubernetes container orchestration system.

cooked.headline: The market just realized AI data centers need more than just vibes to run
cooked.summary: Investors are hitting the panic button as political shifts threaten the massive energy and land requirements of AI infrastructure. Turns out, building a digital brain is a lot harder when the government stops handing you a blank check for your power bill.
cooked.plain_english: Stock market valuations for companies focused on artificial intelligence decreased significantly due to concerns over new political policies affecting data center expansion.

cooked.headline: Tesla and SpaceX lost $420 billion, proving even the market has a sense of irony
cooked.summary: Watching two companies lose nearly half a trillion in value in 48 hours is like watching a production build fail right after you pushed to main on a Friday. It's a brutal reminder that even main character energy can't stop the stock market from throwing a tantrum.
cooked.plain_english: Tesla and SpaceX experienced a combined market value loss of over $420 billion during a two-day period.

cooked.headline: Anthropic's IPO valuation just dropped by a casual billion
cooked.summary: Investors are finally realizing that burning through venture capital to train models isn't quite the same thing as printing money. It turns out that even with a trillion-dollar price tag, you still need to actually make a profit eventually.
cooked.plain_english: Anthropic has lowered its expected valuation for its initial public offering following concerns from major investors.

cooked.headline: Meta's new business model is apparently just facilitating deepfake scams
cooked.summary: Documents suggest Meta knowingly kept the lights on for AI-powered fraud to the tune of $16 billion in revenue. It's the ultimate version of 'I don't make the rules, I just sell the ad space' for the digital age.
cooked.plain_english: Internal documents indicate that Meta was aware of and profited from scam advertisements featuring AI-generated deepfakes.

cooked.headline: Microsoft realizes that renting someone else's AI capacity is just paying for a middleman.
cooked.summary: Microsoft is winding down its deal to rent AI cloud capacity from Oracle because apparently, even tech giants get tired of paying rent. It turns out that when you have your own data centers, paying a competitor to host your servers is just a very expensive way to admit you weren't ready.
cooked.plain_english: Microsoft is ending its agreement to use Oracle's cloud infrastructure for its artificial intelligence services.

cooked.headline: MS Paint is now a professional-grade attack vector
cooked.summary: You can now technically get pwned by a drawing of a stick figure if you open the wrong BMP file. It's comforting to know that even after decades of security patches, our greatest vulnerability remains a 1985 graphics editor.
cooked.plain_english: A security vulnerability in Microsoft Paint allows attackers to execute malicious code on a computer when a specially crafted image file is opened.

cooked.headline: The FAA is speedrunning a 2028 retirement for floppy disks
cooked.summary: The air traffic control system is currently running on technology that hasn't been relevant since the invention of the internet. It turns out the biggest threat to aviation isn't turbulence, but finding a drive that can still read a 3.5-inch disk.
cooked.plain_english: The Federal Aviation Administration plans to replace the legacy computer systems that still rely on floppy disks for air traffic control operations by 2028.

cooked.headline: Claude Code is leaking your email like a sieve in a rainstorm
cooked.summary: Anthropic built an AI agent to help you code, but it's apparently been handing out your personal email address to every website it visits. It's the digital equivalent of a helpful assistant who thinks your private contact info is a business card for the public.
cooked.plain_english: The Claude Code software tool is accidentally sharing user email addresses with websites it accesses during its operation.
